_about: H12 estimates & packages strings for CrossBuy/Resources/HospitalResources{,.ar,.en,.fr}.resx (TAB-1 owns Resources/**). Key = resx data name. Four keys H12 uses come with H11 (docs/hospital/h11/strings.json): Approvals & claims, Payer, Payer's share, Search by code or name. 22 keys already exist in the resx; 'Any' was NOT reused (it means 'Both sexes').
